task.title: Release and seal a pack
task.shortdesc: Only a code owner of the AEGIS repository can release a pack. Release seals it in Cloud Storage and writes a register row.

step.cmd: Open an issue and choose the reader.

info.p: A workflow runs the four checks, builds the pack with DITA-OT and posts the report on the issue.

step.cmd: As the compliance lead, comment /release on the issue.

info.p: The workflow refuses a release from anyone who isn't a code owner, and refuses a blocked pack.

result.p: The pack is uploaded to the evidence bucket with a retention policy, its manifest records who released it, and the register shows it on the sandbox page. The proof of concept uses a short, unlocked retention policy, because a locked policy can't be removed or shortened.
